meta.layout: one row per anim x dir (down,left,right,up): lightning 12, blink_vanish 10, blink_appear 8, leech 12, shield 12
meta.releaseNote: 0-based frame index; fire on ANIMATION_UPDATE when frame.index==release+1 (Phaser frames are 1-based) or listen per README. blink: teleport after the LAST vanish frame (ANIMATION_COMPLETE), then play appear.
meta.spawnNote: pixels relative to the sprite origin (feet). lightning/leech: projectile start at the casting hand; shield: overlay goes on the mage origin.
